report.description: DealCloud is a CRM and deal‑management platform for principal investing and M&A advisory professionals. It offers a RESTful API that requires user‑specific credentials (API keys or OAuth tokens) and provides access to functional endpoints, with a new Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for read‑only data access in preview.
report.main_blocker: The MCP server is only available as a client preview starting July 2026, requires the DealCloud with Celeste license, and currently provides read‑only access, limiting full integration capabilities.

evidence.claim: API requires user‑specific credentials and can use a dedicated service account
API keys are used for authentication and must be treated like passwords
DealCloud MCP Server announced as a client preview starting July 2026
MCP preview requires the DealCloud with Celeste license and provides read‑only access
Developer portal lists API documentation and references REST APIs
